title: incident-bot: guided diagnostics actions and quickrun playbooks
author: Jordan Rivera
description: Summary: Add guided diagnostics actions and 'QuickRun' playbook integration to incident-bot to help on-call engineers run common diagnostics and remediation steps directly from alerts. Motivation: During recent pages the on-call flow required manual lookups and copying commands from runbooks into terminals; this PR surfaces curated, safe actions and short playbooks to reduce time-to-diagnosis and mean-time-to-resolution. Changes: 1) Add a new actions subsystem with typed action definitions (shell-run, kubectl-check, query-metric, toggle-rollout). 2) Integrate 'QuickRun' playbooks stored in the runbook registry and expose them as sequenced guided actions in the alert card. 3) Feature-flagged rollout with per-team opt-in via incident-bot config. 4) Telemetry: emit action.invoked, action.result, playbook.completed metrics and tracing spans. 5) Safety: actions requiring destructive privileges require explicit approval and are gated by RBAC checks; added confirmations and rate-limits. 6) CLI and Slack command support for invoking guided actions when responding on-call. 7) Tests: unit tests for action executor, integration tests for playbook sequencing, and e2e test harness updated to simulate oncall flows. 8) Docs: runbook authoring section updated with action templates and examples. Testing & CI: Ran unit and integration suites locally and in CI; addressed a flaky test in the e2e harness by increasing a timeout and adding better retries. Performance: action execution path is non-blocking for the main event loop and uses a worker pool capped per-team to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. Rollout plan: feature-flag defaults off; staged rollout to SRE and Platform teams for 2 weeks, then broader rollout pending metrics. Related work: builds on earlier runbook linking and diagnostics improvements (see ENG-6123, PRs: pr-41234, pr-48231). Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] telemetry emitted [x] docs updated [x] feature flag gating [x] security review OK

release_notes: Add guided diagnostics actions and QuickRun playbooks to incident-bot. Playbooks can be authored in the runbook registry and executed as sequenced guided actions; telemetry added for action usage and results; feature-flagged rollout and per-team concurrency controls.
notes: This PR is a follow-on to previous diagnostics/runbook efforts; signoff from security and SRE required before wide rollout. The feature flag is incident_bot.guided_actions and can be enabled per-team in configs/incident-bot.yaml.
